lines.text: Adonijah asks Bathsheba to request Abishag the Shunammite as his wife from King Solomon.
Solomon seats Bathsheba at his right hand, then has Benaiah strike down Adonijah, who asked for Abishag.
Solomon sends Abiathar to Anathoth and banishes him from the priesthood, fulfilling the LORD's word spoken at Shiloh against Eli's house.
Joab flees to the tent of the LORD and grips the altar's horns, but Benaiah kills him there, and Solomon puts Zadok over the army.

wrong_details.wrong: Solomon puts Zadok over the army
wrong_details.true: Solomon appoints Benaiah over the army in Joab's place, and Zadok the priest in Abiathar's place

Joab is struck down after refusing to leave and is buried at his own home in the wilderness; the line says he died at the tent only by implication, but Joab said he would die there and Benaiah did kill him there per the king's order

lines.text: Solomon forbids Shimei to cross the Jordan River on pain of death, and after Shimei goes to Gath, Benaiah strikes him down.
